items.title: 박보검, 구찌 글로벌 앰버서더 선정 "기쁘고 기대된다"[공식]
items.summary: Gucci officially named Korean actor Park Bo-gum as its new global brand ambassador. Park said he is delighted to write a new chapter atop Gucci's century-old heritage under creative director Demna. Company framed the pick as aligned with the house's aesthetic direction.

items.title: 박보검 '구찌 왕자' 됐다···새 글로벌 행보
items.summary: Korean entertainment-business coverage of Park Bo-gum's appointment as Gucci global ambassador, framing it as a significant career milestone and a new phase of global activity for the actor.

items.title: 더 자유롭고 더 담대하게, 박보검 (W Korea Vol.11 cover story)
items.summary: W Korea's November issue (Vol. 11) cover story styled Park Bo-gum head-to-toe in Gucci ahead of his ambassador announcement, part of a wider W Korea November set also featuring aespa's Ningning and Stray Kids' Lee Know in Gucci looks. Gucci's official Instagram reposted the cover.

items.title: 박보검 구찌 오늘자 얼굴...jpg (LACMA Art+Film Gala)
items.summary: Korean community thread sharing photos of Park Bo-gum at the Gucci-presented LACMA Art+Film Gala (Nov 7, 2026), his first public appearance since being named ambassador. Comment sentiment overwhelmingly positive, praising his styling and look.

items.title: 싱글벙글 명품 브랜드 구찌 근황
items.summary: Widely-viewed DC Inside thread mocking Gucci for cost-cutting by selling China-made sneakers under a new release while framing it as new product, calling the move a sign of revenue decline. Negative/mocking sentiment; top comment notes other luxury houses face similar struggles.

items.title: 연말 시즌 앞두고 명품 가격 'N차 인상'···"한국만 배짱장사" 비판 확산
items.summary: Report that Gucci quietly raised prices on multiple bags in late October without notice (e.g. Marmont mini shoulder bag +9.5%, Ophidia small tote also up), part of a pattern of repeated 'n-th' price hikes across luxury houses. Criticism spreading that brands price-gouge specifically in the Korean market.

items.title: 명품 줄줄이 'n차' 인상…에르메스·구찌 이어 루이비통도 뛰어
items.summary: Broadcast-affiliated outlet reports Hermes and Gucci raised prices again last quarter, with Louis Vuitton following; frames this as an industry-wide pattern of off-cycle repeated price increases hitting Korean consumers.

items.title: 구찌, 글로벌 앰버서더에 박보검 선정
items.summary: Trade-press confirmation of Park Bo-gum's appointment as Gucci global ambassador, framed within industry coverage of Korean celebrity luxury-ambassador deals.

items.title: グッチの新型バッグ「グッチ NY トートバッグ」が登場！伊勢丹新宿店で「GucciCore」ポップアップを開催
items.summary: Isetan Shinjuku hosted a GucciCore pop-up (Nov 4-10) launching a new Gucci NY Tote bag inspired by New York street style, described as the fourth chapter of Demna's exploration of Gucci codes; a small-size version of the tote is Japan-exclusive.

items.title: 【GUCCI】「GucciCore」のローンチを記念し、東京でのポップアップショップと日本限定モデル〔グッチ NY トートバッグ〕が登場
items.summary: Japanese fashion-lifestyle outlet covers the Tokyo GucciCore pop-up launch and the Japan-exclusive small NY Tote Bag model, positioning it within Demna's ongoing reinterpretation of Gucci archive codes for a New York theme.

items.title: グッチ、マライア・キャリーを起用した新たなホリデーキャンペーンを発表
items.summary: Gucci unveiled a holiday gift campaign for 2026 featuring celebrity talent, spotlighting bags/shoes such as the Starlet and GG Marmont as seasonal gift picks for the Japanese market.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？关店125家后业绩转正，3个维度说清+FAQ
items.summary: Weibo explainer-style post summarizing Gucci's 2026 situation: closed 105 of a planned 125 net stores globally (concentrated in Asia) while comparable sales show early signs of stabilizing; frames the closures as a deliberate flagship-focus strategy rather than pure retreat.

items.title: 古驰破天荒"中国制造"、Demna第二秀、降价30%自救，这波大新闻到底值不值得关注？
items.summary: Weibo post discussing Gucci's first-ever 'Made in China' label on its $1,000 Drip sneaker, breaking the brand's longstanding 'Made in Italy' positioning; split reactions among commenters, some saying it 'cheapens' luxury feel, others saying origin doesn't matter if quality holds.

items.title: 140만원짜리 구찌 신발에 붙은 '메이드인 차이나'…'중국산 명품' 통할까
items.summary: Korean trade coverage of Gucci's Drip sneaker carrying a 'Made in China' label for the first time, priced at roughly 1.4 million won; piece questions whether Chinese manufacturing will dent the brand's craftsmanship image given recent revenue declines and store closures.

items.title: 명품 순위 정해준다 인정하면 개추 (명품 갤러리 토론 스레드)
items.summary: Luxury-focused DC Inside gallery thread ranking major luxury houses; Gucci discussed among comments debating its current standing relative to Chanel, Dior, Hermès amid its ongoing creative/commercial reset under Demna. Mixed, often skeptical tone about Gucci's current tier.

items.title: Gucci, Prada close more China outlets as consumers cut luxury spending
items.summary: SCMP reports Kering closed two long-standing Gucci stores in Shanghai (Réel Department Store near Jing'an Temple and New World Daimaru on Nanjing Road) after a decade-plus presence, part of a broader pullback as Chinese luxury demand softens.

items.title: 구찌 매출 8% 급감…중동 전쟁에 회복 기대 지연
items.summary: Background piece (older but relevant context corroborated by newer Q3 data) on Gucci's revenue decline and delayed recovery expectations; included only as supporting context for the ongoing earnings-pressure narrative, not as a fresh standalone signal.

items.title: 뎀나, 1년간의 탐구 끝에 자신의 비전을 담은 구찌를 완성하다
items.summary: WWD Korea analytical piece on Demna's first full year at Gucci, assessing how his creative vision has materialized across collections; included as trade-press framing for the ambassador/campaign news cycle, though dated outside the strict freshness window.
